'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the drawers, the message "The drawers are locked!  A note left on the drawers reads: Shiver me timbers!" is displayed, hinting that one of the pirates around [[Brimhaven]] must be killed to get the key.
